report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; traces show successful 200s across checkout, order, inventory, payment, redis and postgres spans with no errors. Metrics show /v1/checkout 502 count of 0 and p95 ~247ms. No evidence establishes any taxonomy fault (no 500s, no pool exhaustion, no timeouts, no deployment facts, no memory-retention data). The alert does not demonstrate a real fault, so no bounded candidate is supported; hand off for baseline comparison and log review.
